What it is

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Family's comma-shifting amount input - on the dark Send screen, typing digits makes the giant dollar amount reformat live: commas animate into their new places, the text scales down to fit, and a red "not enough ETH" error springs in past the balance - then everything reverses cleanly on delete.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Family's comma-shifting amount input - on the dark Send screen, typing digits makes the giant dollar amount reformat live: commas animate into their new places, the text scales down to fit, and a red "not enough ETH" error springs in past the balance - then everything reverses cleanly on delete.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark Send screen: "To: Benjamin" row, giant amount ("$100", "$1,000", "$10,000", "$100,000", "$1,000,000", "$10,000,000"), ETH conversion beneath, Ethereum row with "Use Max", numpad (pressed key shows a dark circle highlight), Continue. Past the balance a red "not enough ETH" line appears under the conversion.

## Motion spec
Pattern: live grouping-separator animation with stepped type scaling.
- Each keypress: the pressed numpad key flashes its highlight (100ms), the new digit slides up into the amount string (150ms ease-out), and existing digits reflow to their new positions (150ms, ease-out).
- Commas animate: when a grouping boundary moves, the comma detaches, glides to its new slot (200ms, ease-in-out), and fades in; a comma that disappears fades out (150ms) - the thousand/million transition visibly re-seats the separators.
- Font size steps down as the string grows (72 -> 64 -> 56 -> 48pt, 200ms ease) so one line always fits; the string re-centers each step.
- The ETH conversion rolls digits (150ms).
- Crossing the balance: the red error line springs in (translateY 6pt -> 0, opacity, spring ~340/18, 250ms) and Continue disables (white -> gray, 200ms); deleting back under the balance dismisses it (150ms) and re-enables Continue.

## Calibration
- Only the amount string animates its layout; the numpad and asset row stay still.
- Size steps are discrete per digit count, matching the native formatter.

## Reduced motion
Digits, commas, and error crossfade (150ms) without springs.

## Don't miss
- The mid-transition frame shows the comma physically between positions - the separator travels, it doesn't pop.
- The delete key gets the same highlight treatment, and deletions reverse every animation.
